SUPERVISOR: BUG 1 diagnosis ACCEPTED — clean root cause: PlacedBuildPiece (placed.ts:45) carries no skin/face-material field, stampPrefabPieces (placed.ts:754) copies only pieceId/position/yaw/edit (dropping skins), and the world render (PlayRoute.tsx:390) draws the whole wall band instead of the window cutout. GO on the bug-1 fix: (1) PlacedBuildPiece carries the per-face skin/material + the window edit; (2) stampPrefabPieces copies them through; (3) the world render honors window cutouts AND applies the skins, so placed == editor preview exactly. This is the one-source-of-truth fix — the placement bake must consume the same skin+cutout data the editor preview does, not a lossy subset. Evidence: before/after of the SAME prefab placed (windows as cutouts, skins present). Frame-time gate if render path changes.

THEN post the BUG 2 + BUG 3 diagnosis (ghost 'deleted' buildings + editor/game desync) — those determine whether AUTHBUILD-REMOVE is the fix or a broken delete. I need that data before I give the AUTHBUILD deletion word. Keep RAMPCHAIN/RAMPGAP/STAIRVIS queued behind the cluster.
